map.按盘厚、MIN 极限与跳动量判断刹车盘能否继续使用，并估算剩余可磨寿命。: Judges from disc thickness, the MIN limit and runout whether a disc can remain in service, and estimates its remaining serviceable life.
map.本盘已行驶里程 (万 km): Distance covered on this disc (10,000 km)
map.刹车盘磨损：总可磨厚度 = 新品厚度 − 极限厚度；已磨损 = 新品 − 当前；: Brake disc wear: total machinable thickness = new thickness − limit thickness; worn = new − current; remaining = current − limit; wear rate = worn ÷ distance; projected service distance = remaining ÷ wear rate.
map.📖 盘厚、跳动量与判定标准: 📖 Disc Thickness, Runout and Judgement Criteria
map.继续使用，按里程复查: Keep in service, recheck by mileage
map.临近极限，安排下次保养换盘: Nearing the limit, plan replacement at the next service
map.可光盘一次（光盘后须仍高于 MIN）: May be machined once (and stay above MIN afterwards)
map.🧰 盘与片要配对: 🧰 Discs and Pads Come as a Pair
map.新片配旧盘（盘面有沟槽）会降低贴合面积与散热，建议同轴成对更换，或至少对旧盘做一: New pads on an old grooved disc reduce contact area and heat dissipation; replace them together on the same axle, or at least machine the old disc once.
map.磨损率 = 已磨厚度 ÷ 已行驶里程。市区频繁制动、山路下坡、重载都会显著抬高磨: Wear rate = thickness worn ÷ distance covered. Frequent urban braking, mountain descents and heavy loads all raise the rate sharply, so remaining life is only a guide.
map.💡 厚度须用千分尺或卡尺在盘面多点测量取最小值；跳动量须拆轮后用百分表测。目视或: 💡 Thickness must be measured at several points on the disc face with a micrometer or caliper and the smallest value taken; runout needs a dial gauge with the wheel removed. Neither looking nor feeling is a substitute.
map.📚 深度解析：刹车盘磨损与更换: 📚 In-depth: Brake Disc Wear and Replacement
map.保养时量刹车盘厚度，对比最小极限（MIN）判断能否继续使用。: At service, measure disc thickness and compare with the minimum (MIN) to judge whether the disc can stay.
map.出现抖动（盘面不平）时测跳动量，决定是否光盘或换盘。: With juddering (an uneven disc face), measure runout to decide between machining and replacement.
map.配对更换与刹车片，保证制动平衡。: Replace discs together with pads to keep braking balanced.
map.盘标 MIN 厚度如 22mm，实测 23.5mm、新品 25mm，已磨 1.5: A disc marked MIN 22mm measuring 23.5mm against 25mm new has lost 1.5mm and can stay in service; at 22.2mm it is close to the limit and should be replaced. Runout beyond 0.05mm causes high-speed judder and may be machined once, provided the disc remains above MIN afterwards.
map.盘和片要一起换吗？: Should discs and pads be replaced together?
map.新片配已磨损旧盘会降低贴合与散热，建议同对更换或至少光盘旧盘。单侧更换易制动跑偏: New pads on a worn disc give poorer contact and cooling, so replace them as a set on the axle or at least machine the disc. Changing one side only tends to make the car pull under braking.
map.多为盘面不平（热变形、硬点）或安装不当。测跳动量，超差光盘，厚度已近极限则直接换: Usually an uneven disc surface (heat distortion, hard spots) or poor installation. Measure runout, machine it if beyond tolerance, and replace outright if thickness is already near the limit.
map.厚度须多点实测取最小值，跳动量须用百分表测量，不可目视替代: Thickness must be measured at several points taking the smallest reading; runout requires a dial gauge, never a visual guess
